by_total.query: SELECT identity.resolve_auth_session($1)

SELECT s.user_id FROM identity.auth_sessions s
    JOIN identity.users u ON u.id = s.user_id
   WHERE s.token_hash = p_token_hash AND s.expires_at > now() AND u.status = $2

SELECT kind, version, granted_at, withdrawn_at FROM identity.consents
         WHERE user_id = $1
           AND (kind, version) IN (('terms', $2), ('privacy', $3),
                                   ('voice_recording', $4))

SELECT c.id, c.session_id, c.slot, c.mark_id, c.written_form, c.heard_form, c.at_ms, c.created_at, s.content_id, $5 || s.content_id || $6 || c.at_ms AS source_url
        FROM practice.cards c JOIN practice.sessions s ON s.id=c.session_id AND s.user_id=c.user_id
        WHERE (CAST($1 AS uuid) IS NULL OR c.session_id=$1)
        AND (CAST($2 AS timestamptz) IS NULL OR (c.created_at,c.id)<($2,$3))
        ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT $4

SELECT id, user_id, content_id, passage, entry, status, version,
       entry_locked_at, completed_at, created_at, updated_at
  FROM practice.sessions
 WHERE id = $1

SELECT step, position, status FROM practice.session_steps
             WHERE session_id = $1 ORDER BY position

UPDATE practice.blind_attempts
               SET last_position_ms = $1,
                   last_heartbeat_at = $2,
                   anchor_position_ms = $3,
                   anchor_at = $4,
                   buffering_ms = $5,
                   resume_count = $6,
                   resume_stop_ms = $7,
                   media_expires_at = greatest(media_expires_at, $8),
                   void_reason = coalesce($9, void_reason),
                   gist_text = coalesce($10, gist_text)
             WHERE attempt_id = $11
            RETURNING attempt_id, user_id, media_token_hash, media_expires_at, passage_start_ms,
    passage_end_ms, last_position_ms, last_heartbeat_at, anchor_position_ms, anchor_at,
    buffering_ms, resume_count, resume_stop_ms, void_reason, gist_text

SELECT id, status, task_name, priority, lock, queueing_lock, args, scheduled_at, queue_name, attempts, worker_id
    FROM procrastinate_fetch_job_v2($1::varchar[], $2)

INSERT INTO ops.analytics_events
  (id, user_id, event_type, subject_id, step, content_id, session_id, properties)
VALUES
  ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7,

ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

SELECT c.id, c.title, m.source, m.status, m.duration_ms, c.created_at,
                   m.id, m.has_video, c.keep_video, m.error_code, 
       CASE WHEN m.status NOT IN ('pending', 'downloading') THEN NULL
            WHEN m.status = 'pending' AND u.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND u.queued_at IS NULL
              THEN 'queued'
            WHEN m.status = 'downloading' THEN coalesce(m.stage, 'downloading')
            ELSE coalesce(m.stage, 'waiting') END,
       CASE WHEN m.status = 'pending' AND u.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND u.queued_at IS NULL
            THEN (SELECT count(*) FROM content.uploads h
                    JOIN content.media_objects hm ON hm.id = h.media_object_id
                   WHERE h.user_id = c.user_id AND hm.status = 'pending'
                     AND h.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND h.queued_at IS NULL
                     AND (h.confirmed_at, h.id) <= (u.confirmed_at, u.id)) END

              FROM content.contents c
              JOIN content.media_objects m ON m.id = c.media_object_id
              LEFT JOIN content.uploads u ON u.content_id = c.id
             WHERE c.id = $1 AND c.user_id = $2

SELECT c.id, c.title, m.source, m.status, m.duration_ms, c.created_at, 
       CASE WHEN m.status NOT IN ('pending', 'downloading') THEN NULL
            WHEN m.status = 'pending' AND u.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND u.queued_at IS NULL
              THEN 'queued'
            WHEN m.status = 'downloading' THEN coalesce(m.stage, 'downloading')
            ELSE coalesce(m.stage, 'waiting') END,
       CASE WHEN m.status = 'pending' AND u.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND u.queued_at IS NULL
            THEN (SELECT count(*) FROM content.uploads h
                    JOIN content.media_objects hm ON hm.id = h.media_object_id
                   WHERE h.user_id = c.user_id AND hm.status = 'pending'
                     AND h.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND h.queued_at IS NULL
                     AND (h.confirmed_at, h.id) <= (u.confirmed_at, u.id)) END

  FROM content.contents c
  JOIN content.media_objects m ON m.id = c.media_object_id
  LEFT JOIN content.uploads u ON u.content_id = c.id
 WHERE c.user_id = $1 ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT $2

WITH inserted_jobs AS (
        INSERT INTO procrastinate_jobs (queue_name, task_name, priority, lock, queueing_lock, args, scheduled_at)
        SELECT (job).queue_name,
               (job).task_name,
               (job).priority,
               (job).lock,
               (job).queueing_lock,
               (job).args,
               (job).scheduled_at
        FROM unnest(jobs) AS job
        RETURNING id
    )
    SELECT array_agg(id) FROM inserted_jobs

UPDATE procrastinate_periodic_defers
        SET job_id = (
            SELECT COALESCE((
                SELECT unnest(procrastinate_defer_jobs_v1(
                    ARRAY[
                        ROW(
                            _queue_name,
                            _task_name,
                            _priority,
                            _lock,
                            _queueing_lock,
                            _args,
                            NULL::timestamptz
                        )
                    ]::procrastinate_job_to_defer_v1[]
                ))
            ), NULL)
        )
        WHERE id = _defer_id
        RETURNING job_id

        FROM practice.cards c JOIN practice.sessions s ON s.id=c.session_id AND s.user_id=c.user_id
        WHERE (CAST($1 AS uuid) IS NULL OR c.session_id=$1)
        AND (CAST($2 AS timestamptz) IS NULL OR (c.created_at,c.id)<($2,$3))
        ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT $4

        SET status = end_status,
            abort_requested = $3,
            attempts = CASE status
                WHEN $4 THEN attempts + $5 ELSE attempts
            END
        WHERE id = job_id AND status IN ($6, $7)

SELECT procrastinate_update_heartbeat_v1($1)

WITH candidate AS (
        SELECT jobs.*
            FROM procrastinate_jobs AS jobs
            WHERE
                -- reject the job if its lock has earlier or higher priority jobs
                NOT EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                        FROM procrastinate_jobs AS other_jobs
                        WHERE
                            jobs.lock IS NOT NULL
                            AND other_jobs.lock = jobs.lock
                            AND (
                                -- job with same lock is already running
                                other_jobs.status = 'doing'
                                OR
                                -- job with same lock is waiting and has higher priority (or same priority but was queued first)
                                (
                                    other_jobs.status = 'todo'
                                    AND (
                                        other_jobs.priority > jobs.priority
                                        OR (
                                        other_jobs.priority = jobs.priority
                                        AND other_jobs.id < jobs.id
                                        )
                                    )
                                )
                            )
                )
                AND jobs.status = 'todo'
                AND (target_queue_names IS NULL OR jobs.queue_name = ANY( target_queue_names ))
                AND (jobs.scheduled_at IS NULL OR jobs.scheduled_at <= now())
            ORDER BY jobs.priority DESC, jobs.id ASC LIMIT 1
            FOR UPDATE OF jobs SKIP LOCKED
    )
    UPDATE procrastinate_jobs
        SET status = 'doing', worker_id = p_worker_id
        FROM candidate
        WHERE procrastinate_jobs.id = candidate.id
        RETURNING procrastinate_jobs.*

UPDATE practice.dictation_attempts
               SET draft_text = $1, draft_version = draft_version + $4
             WHERE attempt_id = $2 AND draft_version = $3

SELECT c.id, c.title, m.source, m.status, m.duration_ms, c.created_at, 
       CASE WHEN m.status NOT IN ('pending', 'downloading') THEN NULL
            WHEN m.status = 'pending' AND u.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND u.queued_at IS NULL
              THEN 'queued'
            WHEN m.status = 'downloading' THEN coalesce(m.stage, 'downloading')
            ELSE coalesce(m.stage, 'waiting') END,
       CASE WHEN m.status = 'pending' AND u.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND u.queued_at IS NULL
            THEN (SELECT count(*) FROM content.uploads h
                    JOIN content.media_objects hm ON hm.id = h.media_object_id
                   WHERE h.user_id = c.user_id AND hm.status = 'pending'
                     AND h.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND h.queued_at IS NULL
                     AND (h.confirmed_at, h.id) <= (u.confirmed_at, u.id)) END

  FROM content.contents c
  JOIN content.media_objects m ON m.id = c.media_object_id
  LEFT JOIN content.uploads u ON u.content_id = c.id
 WHERE c.user_id = $1 ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT $2
